name: Sabine Hale - Candidate 1
description: A distinctly female voice belonging to a woman in her early thirties, a native Eastern European speaker of English with a light, clear Polish accent. Excellent studio recording quality. Low, steady lower-middle register with a slightly husky, dry texture. A former convoy escort commander now leading marines on the ground: calm, measured and exact. She never raises her voice; urgency shows in shorter, clipped sentences and firm consonants rather than volume. Even, deliberate pacing, about 150 words per minute, with brief pauses between counted facts. Quiet warmth for her own people, beneath a reserved, unhurried manner. Everyday spoken radio dialogue, not narration or performance.
provenance: Original ElevenLabs Voice Design, candidate 1 of one preview request. Approved by the owner on eleven_v4 after emotion tests; v4 does not keep the designed Eastern European accent, and the owner accepted the voice without it. No game recordings uploaded or cloned.
